title: Left Edge Sneaker Stays Visible
tests: Tests subject-aware reframing of an off-centre product instead of a default centre crop that loses the subject.

faults.what: The crop cuts off the heel and rear section of the sneaker at the left edge, despite the explicit instruction to keep the entire shoe.
The plain right-side strip has a conspicuous vertical boundary against the photographic background rather than blending seamlessly.

judge.summary: The output is square but shows an enlarged, cropped portion of the sneaker with the heel missing.

must_haves.why: The output has equal width and height.

must_haves.item: The output includes the original left-side sneaker, not an empty crop of the middle of the source.
must_haves.why: The original sneaker is present, though only partially.

must_haves.item: The complete sneaker remains visible, including toe, heel and sole.
must_haves.why: The heel and rear sole are outside the left edge of the output.

must_haves.item: The sneaker's proportions, colour and details match the source.
must_haves.why: The visible portion retains the source's white colour, stitching, laces and proportions, although it is enlarged.

must_haves.item: Any added padding blends with the source background, with no text or decorative additions.
must_haves.why: There are no text or decorative additions, but the plain right strip meets the photographic background at an obvious hard seam.
